svg.title: An agent is a system, not a prompt
svg.desc: A hand-drawn component map. Context, memory, and tools feed an orchestrator that plans, acts, and adapts; guardrails and evaluation sit underneath it, and a dashed edge carries what evaluation learns back to the orchestrator. Reliability comes from that loop rather than from one clever instruction.
svg.text: An Agent Is a System, Not a Prompt
Context, memory, tools, guardrails, and evaluation make it reliable.
Reliability comes from the loop — not from one clever instruction.
